# 00000007601

**GA5-01 ◆** — source: 239_几何代数III.md

**English.** Definition: Clifford algebras as algebras generated by quadratic forms. Conjecture: The product decomposes into symmetric plus antisymmetric parts and the combination of the decomposition is the commutator structure; the symmetric part is inner-product type; the antisymmetric part is outer-product type; and the orthogonality of the decomposition is given by the metric. (symmetric-antisymmetric Clifford product decomposition)

**中文。** 定义：Clifford 代数：二次型生成的代数。猜想：乘积分解为对称加反对称两部分且分解的组合为换位结构；对称部为内积型；反对称部为外积型；分解的正交性由度规给出。（Clifford 乘积对称反对称分解）
